claim: Arts and crafts concern expression, movement and exploring materials. The quoted Montessori response about artistic development remains attributed.

claim: A home may include selected open-ended toys and daily-life imaginative play. Begin with existing favorites, donate unused items and rotate some from storage. Davies treats these alongside purposeful activities. If attending Montessori preschool, she advises retaining school materials' novelty and using daily life, creativity, outdoor time, unstructured play and rest at home.
